definitions.explanation: Tools and equipment used in farming and agriculture, such as hoes, sickles, plows, and rakes. Includes both traditional hand tools and modern implements.

examples.japanese: {農具|のうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しまった。
examples.english: I put the farming tools away in the shed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農具|のうぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Old farming tools are displayed in the museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農具|のうぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさなかった→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather never neglected the maintenance of his farming tools.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in agricultural, historical, and museum contexts. Traditional Japanese {農具|のうぐ} like ⟦{鎌|かま}→鎌：16402_kama⟧ (sickle), ⟦{鍬|くわ}→鍬：08280_kuwa⟧ (hoe), and ⟦{鋤|すき}→鋤：27971_suki⟧ (plow) are important cultural artifacts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農具|のうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use farming tools)
- {農具|のうぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧ (maintenance of farming tools)
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{農具|のうぐ} (traditional farming implements)
- {農具|のうぐ}{小屋|ごや} (tool shed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工具|こうぐ}→工具：01401_kougu⟧: tools — general tools for construction or repair work
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: implements, tools — the broadest general term for tools of any kind
